The Zendesk Reseller API is only accessible to Zendesk partners and resellers. If you are a partner and want to gain access, email us at partners@zendesk.com.

## Introduction ### What is this API? The Zendesk Reseller API allows you, as a reseller partner of Zendesk, to create new Zendesk Support instances. Zendesk partners can use the Reseller API to create Zendesk Support trial accounts. Partners can also configure the provisioned accounts with certain settings. ### How to get access? The Zendesk Partner Portal allows you to create and manage Zendesk Support instances, as well as export account status, billing data, and leads linked to your referral or reseller account. If you have questions about onboarding a new Zendesk Support customer, contact us at partners@zendesk.com. To become a Zendesk reseller or partner, complete the [Zendesk Partner application form](https://www.zendesk.com/partner/). If you are already a partner and want to gain access to our Reseller API, email us at partners@zendesk.com.
